H19-A.unit: fold 0: inner-cross-fit difficulty LGBM (~0.5h) + baseline and reweighted LGBM members (~1h each) + shared-fail pair scoring; folds 1-4 replication only if fold-0 shows a path

H19-B.unit: pseudo-test: carve fold 4 holdout; train 5 fold-fit members on folds 0-3 inner split + 1 full-fit member on folds 0-3; predict holdout; LGBM members ~15min each

H19-C.unit: fold 0 nearest-key smoothed TE feature + baseline vs +feature LGBM + unique-key subset AUC

rationale_gpu_zero: The top-3 ranked hypotheses (H19-A reweighted member, H19-B deployment pseudo-test, H19-C smoothed key) are all CPU LightGBM experiments. H19-E (neural) is a reserve with a strong negative prior (~1e-3 below champion) and is not worth GPU spend. The 12h GPU ceiling is held in reserve should a concrete neural or TabPFN-side hypothesis emerge that plausibly closes a 1e-3 gap; none currently does.
